input.quote: Corio to pay Commerce One [*] of all Application Management Revenue from Corio Customers for use of Commerce One Software or MarketSite.net Service Access subject to the following limitations.
input.rationale: Fees are usage- and revenue-based (licence fees, annual maintenance, revenue share on actual Customer revenue, implementation on time and materials with a cap); there is no minimum purchase, take-or-pay or shortfall payment binding us. The "minimum limitation of 40 Authorized Software Users per Customer" is a revenue-share calculation threshold, not a purchase commitment.

input.quote: Upon termination or expiration of this Agreement, each party shall otherwise return or destroy any Confidential Information of the other party provided, however, Corio may retain any Confidential Information necessary for Corio to continue supporting it's then-existing Customers.
input.rationale: Section 11.3 preserves our licence and Commerce One's maintenance obligations for existing Customers, but there is no transition-assistance obligation and no requirement to return or export the data Commerce One holds through the MarketSite.net Service in a machine-readable format. We insert a new Section 11.4 providing up to six months' assistance at then-current rates and 30-day data return with certified deletion (fallback: 90 days' assistance).
